# NPM Improved v1.6.11 — Live Traffic Intelligence

## Investigate traffic on individual hosts

- Open **Analytics Center → HTTP Routes → Live traffic**, or select **Live traffic & threats** from Proxy Host Analytics.
- Monitor a single HTTP route for the latest 5, 15 or 60 minutes. The page refreshes every 10 seconds when active, with Pause and Refresh controls.
- Inspect requests per minute, response bandwidth, unique source IPs, 4xx/5xx responses, recorded blocks, requested paths, claimed browser families and the latest completed requests.
- Use source-scoped links to investigate IP addresses, user agents and individual URL paths in Request History. Request export honors the selected exact path and client filters.
- Review suspicious-client indicators with their specific evidence: sensitive-path probes, concentrated 404 responses, high request rates and already-denied requests. **No automatic blocking is performed.**

## Enforcement and privacy

- Existing IP/CIDR and user-agent substring blocks are **node-wide**, not limited to the selected host. The Blocking screen now requires confirmation of this scope.
- User-agent strings can be spoofed. A client claiming to be YandexBot, Googlebot, etc. does not prove identity or hostile intent.
- This is completed-request analytics from the local NPMi node, not live socket/packet capture. NPMX does not aggregate raw telemetry from other nodes.
- Source addresses can be shared gateways. Geography/ASN enrichment and host-specific or time-limited rules are not yet included; no location is fabricated.
- Raw request paths remain sanitized, and existing permissions, retention, updater flow and Nginx activation/rollback safety remain in force.

## Deployment

- Use **Settings → Update** on supported single-node installations once the release appears.
- For NPMX deployments, follow the coordinated update procedure, updating the primary before secondaries.
- No new containers, API secrets, or external traffic collection services are required.
- v1.6.10 mobile web usability improvements remain part of v1.6.11.

## Validation

- PR #81 passed automated backend and frontend tests, Docker production image/in-place updater integration, and required checks.
- Physical device and representative production-traffic verification should still be performed after upgrading.
